name: Wallow
blurb: Windows desktop client folding WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and Facebook into one lightweight multi-tab window, replacing several heavyweight Electron apps.
detail:
Built in C++ on the WebView2 runtime with a Dear ImGui immediate-mode interface. Implements active memory management: inactive tabs are suspended and their working sets trimmed back to the OS, cutting idle RAM substantially.

Also ships single-instance enforcement via named mutex, system-tray minimisation, per-app cache clearing for privacy, and user-configurable custom tabs, zoom levels, user agents and storage locations. CMake build for Visual Studio 2022.
